programs.description: In the vibrant and bustling landscape of Somnath, a self-owned grocery store serves as the lifeblood of a quintessential Gujarati joint family. Across generations, it stands witness to the ebbs and flows of their journey.
A driven young woman embarks on a journey to fulfil a promise for a better life. Along the way, she overcomes several challenges and crosses paths with a man who complicates everything.

A driven young woman embarks on a journey to fulfil a promise for a better life. Along the way, she overcomes several challenges and crosses paths with a man who complicates everything.
Sailee dreams of marrying her prince charming. However, destiny brings her Sachin, a complex figure.
A young woman is forced to marry a local man. Although she falls in love with him eventually, she continues protesting against the male domination at her in-laws' place.
Deepa leads a tough life in a tradition-bound society that judges her based on skin colour. As luck would have it, she crosses paths with a doctor who helps her redefine beauty through their love.
